info.title: co-ai REST API
info.description: Multi-user project coordination. Project keys can only access their assigned project. Read keys cannot write. User keys manage owned projects. See /llm/API.md. HTTPS only: HTTP API requests return 426 without executing handlers. Disabled users cannot access any API. Archived projects are unavailable to project keys. OAuth authorization-code flow with mandatory S256 PKCE is also supported; access tokens are bound to the REST or MCP resource. Discover /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server and /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/api/v1.

sync_until.description: Inclusive upper bound fixed across all pages of update-based queries; null otherwise. Advance the polling checkpoint only after reading the full window without max_items. Concurrent edits beyond this bound appear in the next poll; latest-state results are not an event history.

default.description: Error. 400 validation, 401 authentication, 403 permission, 404 scoped resource missing, 409 conflict, 413 body size, 415 content type, 500/503 service failure.

426.description: HTTPS required. HTTP requests do not execute operations.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Opaque next_cursor from previous page; preserve filters/order/max_items. Default ID ordering remains compatible.

parameters.name: role_id
parameters.description: Filter by sender role ID, or none for an unassigned sender.

parameters.name: tag

schema.description: Trimmed, NFC normalized, lowercased and deduplicated; no control characters.

parameters.description: Repeated exact TAGs; normalized like writes.

parameters.name: tag_mode
parameters.description: Match all or any requested TAGs.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Item kind.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Literal title/body substring; ASCII case insensitive.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive creation time boundary; timezone required.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Inclusive creation time boundary; timezone required.

parameters.name: max_items
parameters.description: Total cap across all pages, independent of per-page limit.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: newest/oldest sort creation time; updated_newest/updated_oldest sort update time. Default updated_oldest with updated_since, otherwise newest with max_items, otherwise id. Timestamp ties use ID.

parameters.name: recipient_role_id
parameters.description: Filter messages addressed to this role, including ALL broadcasts. ALL returns only broadcasts. Combines with other filters.

parameters.name: updated_since
parameters.description: Inclusive updated_at lower bound; timezone required. Finds edits to older items. Defaults to updated_oldest ordering. Poll all pages without max_items, then reuse sync_until as the next inclusive boundary and deduplicate by item ID/version. Include deleted items to observe tombstones.
